title: SPECIAL TOPICS: ST/ADVANCED UI
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 16 credits
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
A hands-on, exploratory course introducing students to contemporary generative AI tools across text, image, video, 3D modeling, audio, and code. Through guided exercises and creative projects, students experiment with emerging technologies while developing a critical understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and ethical implications. Suitable for students from any discipline interested in how AI can support inquiry, creativity, and innovation.
